## MCP - Syllabus Generator

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/syllabus-generator

**Parameters:**
- `topic` (required): Subject/course topic
- `openai_api_key` (required): OpenAI API key
- `model` (optional): gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini (default: gpt-4o)
- `context` (optional): Additional context or requirements
- `options.level` (optional): debutant | intermediaire | avance (default: intermediaire)
- `options.duration_weeks` (optional): Course duration in weeks (default: 8)
- `options.hours_per_week` (optional): Hours per week (default: 4)
- `options.language` (optional): fr | en (default: fr)
- `options.format` (optional): theorique | pratique | hybride (default: hybride)
- `execution_mode` (optional): online | offline

**Returns:** Complete syllabus with modules, lessons, objectives, assessments, resources
